name: Bob

equipment.name: Chain mail
equipment.notes: AC 16 · heavy armor · disadvantage on Stealth

spells.name: Command
spells.description: Give a one-word command. A target that understands it makes a Wisdom save; restrictions apply.

spells.name: Purify Food and Drink
spells.description: All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range is purified and rendered free of poison and disease. Components: V, S. Ritual tag; the 2014 Paladin class does not grant ritual casting.

spells.name: Bless
spells.description: Up to three creatures add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws. Higher slots add targets.

resources.name: Fire Breath
resources.description: 15 ft cone · Dexterity save · half damage on success.

resources.name: Divine Sense
resources.description: Sense celestials, fiends and undead within 60 ft, except behind total cover, until the end of your next turn.

resources.name: Lay on Hands
resources.description: Touch to restore HP from the pool. Spend 5 points to cure one disease or neutralize one poison.

traits: I proudly introduce myself before every battle: “I am Bob!” I act like a noble hero.
flaws: I rush into danger too quickly.
proficiencies: All armor; shields; simple weapons; martial weapons; playing cards.
notes:
Imported from the June 17, 2026 character sheet and Greatsword Bob conversation. Uses the 2014 fifth-edition Paladin rules.

DM CHECK — The paper sheet lists 120 gp alongside starting gear. Rolled starting gold normally replaces starting equipment; confirm which method your table uses. Do not automatically add the Noble’s 25 gp.

Second martial weapon: not confirmed. Greatsword is confirmed.

Fire resistance: halve fire damage. Position of Privilege: Noble background feature.

Resource counters start full because spent uses were not recorded. XP is set to 0 as a starting placeholder. Equipment weights of 0 mean not recorded, not weightless.

custom.label: Fighting style — Great Weapon Fighting
custom.value: When a damage die for your two-handed melee weapon rolls 1 or 2, reroll it once. You must use the new result. Applies to both of your greatsword’s 2d6 weapon damage dice.

custom.label: Divine Smite
custom.value: When you hit with a melee weapon attack, you may expend a 1st-level spell slot to deal 2d8 extra radiant damage, or 3d8 against an undead or fiend. Decide after the hit. Uses the same two spell slots as your prepared spells; slots return on a long rest. Great Weapon Fighting rerolls only the weapon damage dice, not Divine Smite dice.
